deepseek-v4.1-flash.$comment: pi-ai's opencode-go catalog entry has no compat.supportsReasoningEffort and declares thinkingLevelMap.off: null (off unsupported), so the product could only ever send thinking:{type:"enabled"} with no effort. Probed on the real turn-1/turn-8 requests (long gate #9, 2026-09-25): thinking:{type:"disabled"} is accepted by the endpoint and cuts a 59-92s turn to 3.1-3.5s with tools still called; reasoning_effort low/minimal is accepted but does not reduce reasoning. See docs/kernel-rpc.md §135.27.1.

deepseek-v4-flash.$comment: Same correction as deepseek-v4.1-flash above; not itself probed live, but it is the same opencode-go deepseek family with the same catalog gap.
